ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: REQUIRED. Admin password for RCON and REST API access. Auto-generated per deployment — copy the generated value from the service's Variables tab after deploy. Change it to your own to keep access stable across redeploys.

PLAYERS.description: Maximum number of players allowed to connect simultaneously (1-32). Each player slot consumes additional memory — 4GB RAM recommended for 16+ players.

SERVER_NAME.description: Name shown in the Palworld server browser. Leave as-is for default or customize to help friends find your server.

SERVER_PASSWORD.description: Optional password required to join the server. Leave empty for a public server, or set a password for private access.

COMMUNITY.description: Show this server in the public server browser. Set to false to hide from listings (players can still connect via IP).

RCON_ENABLED.description: Enable remote console (RCON) access. Required for programmatic server management and player moderation tools.

BACKUP_ENABLED.description: Enable automated world backups to the persistent volume. Backups run on a daily schedule by default (configurable via BACKUP_CRON_EXPRESSION).

DELETE_OLD_BACKUPS.description: Automatically delete backups older than OLD_BACKUP_DAYS. Enable to prevent unlimited disk usage on the volume.

OLD_BACKUP_DAYS.description: Number of days to keep backups before deletion (only applies when DELETE_OLD_BACKUPS=true).

TZ.description: Server timezone for cron schedules (backups, updates, reboots). Examples: America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo.
